about.title: About TopDog Labs
about.subtitle: A one-person iOS studio crafting focused, intentional apps.
about.summaryBody: We build iOS apps that feel calm, reliable, and delightful to use. Every project prioritizes clean SwiftUI interfaces, privacy-first decisions, offline-first design, and thoughtful onboarding — so users can jump in and feel at home immediately.

sections.title: What we build
sections.body: Focused mobile experiences: quick-play games, productivity tools, creative utilities, and anything that benefits from native iOS polish. No clutter, no ads, no unnecessary permissions.

sections.title: How we work
sections.body: Small scope, high attention to detail. We ship fast, listen to real users, and iterate steadily. Every release includes accessibility (VoiceOver, Dynamic Type), iCloud sync where it makes sense, and strict attention to modern Swift concurrency and performance.

sections.title: Tech we love
sections.body: SwiftUI for declarative, beautiful UIs • Swift 6 with strict concurrency • CloudKit for seamless iCloud sync • SwiftData for local persistence • RevenueCat for clean premium unlocks • MijickCamera & AVFoundation for advanced capture • Bedrock for consistent design tokens and components • Full accessibility & Dynamic Type support from day one.

sections.title: Guiding principles
sections.body: Privacy by default — no tracking, no analytics, minimal data collection. Offline-first whenever possible. Thoughtful first-time experiences (welcome sheets, spotlight tours). Haptics, animations, and sound used intentionally to make interactions feel premium.

about.closing: TopDog Labs is a solo effort by Matt Bruce in Frisco, Texas. We’re here to ship apps that respect your time and attention.

faq.title: FAQ.
faq.subtitle: Quick answers to common questions.
faq.summaryBody: If you do not see your question, email us at info@topdoglabs.com and we will get back quickly.

sections.title: Where can I get support?
sections.body: Email us anytime at info@topdoglabs.com. Please include the app name, your device model, and the iOS version you are running for faster assistance.

sections.title: Which iOS versions are supported?
sections.body: Most TopDog Labs apps require iOS 17.0 or later to take advantage of the latest SwiftUI and Swift 6 features. Check the individual app's page for specific requirements.

sections.title: Do the apps work on iPad or Mac?
sections.body: Yes! While designed for iPhone, many of our apps are 'Universal' and run natively on iPad. Some are also available as 'Designed for iPad' apps on Apple Silicon-based Mac computers.

sections.title: How is my data handled?
sections.body: Privacy is a core pillar of TopDog Labs. We do not use third-party analytics or tracking. Most apps use iCloud (via Apple's CloudKit) to sync your data privately and securely between your own devices.

sections.title: Are purchases shareable?
sections.body: Yes, we support Apple's Family Sharing for all premium unlocks and one-time purchases. Subscriptions (if applicable) are also shareable according to Apple's policies.

sections.title: How can I suggest a new feature?
sections.body: We love hearing from users! Send your ideas and feedback to info@topdoglabs.com. Many of our best features started as user requests.

sections.title: How often are the apps updated?
sections.body: We ship updates regularly to fix bugs, improve performance, and add new features. We also ensure our apps are updated promptly for every major new iOS release.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.subtitle: Transparency regarding our usage of cookies.
cookies.summaryBody: At TopDog Labs, we believe in minimal data collection. This brochure website is designed to be as private as possible.

sections.title: What are cookies?
sections.body: Cookies are small text files that are placed on your device by websites that you visit. They are widely used to make websites work, or work more efficiently, as well as to provide information to the owners of the site.

sections.title: Our Usage
sections.body: TopDog Labs does not use persistent tracking cookies, advertising cookies, or third-party analytics cookies on this website. We respect your privacy and aim for a cookie-free experience.

sections.title: Essential Cookies
sections.body: If we use any cookies, they are strictly necessary for the technical operation of the site (e.g., to remember your preference for dark mode). These do not track your behavior across other websites.

sections.title: Third-Party Services
sections.body: While our apps may use iCloud (CloudKit) for syncing your data, this brochure website is self-contained and does not load third-party trackers or scripts from social media networks or advertising platforms.

sections.title: How to Control Cookies
sections.body: You can control and/or delete cookies as you wish — for details, see aboutcookies.org. You can delete all cookies that are already on your computer and you can set most browsers to prevent them from being placed.
